links.comparator_used: Alternative HCM probability thresholds (≥0.95, ≥0.90, ≥0.85) of the same AI-ECG algorithm, evaluated on local real-world data
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance for HCM (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, PPV) by probability threshold
links.effect: Threshold ≥0.85: sensitivity 95%, specificity and accuracy all >98%. Threshold ≥0.95: highest PPV (66%) but sensitivity only 50%.
links.tradeoff: A higher threshold raised PPV but cut sensitivity to 50%. The most sensitive threshold (≥0.85) had a lower PPV. Of 1,265 flagged patients, 54.6% had an alternate non-HCM diagnosis.
links.quote: HCM probability threshold of ≥0.85 provided the highest sensitivity (95%) for diagnosis of HCM with high specificity and accuracy (all >98%).
